verdict.rationale: Docs describe a clear deletion mechanism via container-tag scoping (delete a container's content via API/console when a user requests deletion) and self-hosting as an option to keep data entirely local, which supports retention/deletion control. However, there's no documented fine-grained deletion API reference (endpoint specifics), no data retention/expiry policy, and no independent verification of deletion actually working end-to-end. missing for 10: documented deletion API endpoint/spec details, explicit retention/expiry controls, independent confirmation that deletion requests are honored.
